    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

, source_id TEXT, district TEXT, state TEXT, institution_type TEXT, institution_type_source_url TEXT, institution_type_confidence TEXT, institution_type_notes TEXT, institution_type_verified_at TEXT);
CREATE TABLE job_sectors (

    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE node_books (
    node_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    book_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (node_id, book_id)
);
CREATE TABLE node_institutes (
    node_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

    PRIMARY KEY (node_id, institute_id)
);
CREATE TABLE node_job_sectors (
    node_id       INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    job_sector_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES job_sectors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (node_id, job_sector_id)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "career_nodes" (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    slug      TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    stream_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES streams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    parent_id INTEGER REFERENCES "career_nodes"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    name      TEXT NOT NULL,
    intro     TEXT
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_books_title ON books(title);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_institutes_name ON institutes(name);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_job_sectors_name ON job_sectors(name);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_institutes_source_id
            ON institutes(source_id)
            WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_institutes_location
            ON institutes(state, district, city);
CREATE TABLE institute_courses (
            id                  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            source_id           TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
            institute_id        INTEGER NOT NULL
                                    REFERENCES institutes(id)
                                    ON DELETE CASCADE,
            name                TEXT NOT NULL,

            credential          TEXT,
            specialization      TEXT,
            duration            TEXT,
            mode                TEXT,
            eligibility         TEXT,
            official_course_url TEXT NOT NULL,
            verification_status TEXT NOT NULL
        , mapping_gap TEXT);
CREATE INDEX idx_institute_courses_institute
            ON institute_courses(institute_id);
CREATE TABLE course_career_nodes (
            course_id      INTEGER NOT NULL
                               REFERENCES institute_courses(id)
                               ON DELETE CASCADE,
            node_id        INTEGER NOT NULL
                               REFERENCES career_nodes(id)
                               ON DELETE CASCADE,
            relation       TEXT NOT NULL,
            confidence     TEXT NOT NULL,
            mapping_status TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (course_id, node_id)
        );
CREATE INDEX idx_course_career_nodes_node
            ON course_career_nodes(node_id);
CREATE TABLE institute_categories (
            institute_id INTEGER NOT NULL
                             REFERENCES institutes(id)
                             ON DELETE CASCADE,
            category     TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (institute_id, category)
        );
CREATE TABLE institute_rankings (
            institute_id      INTEGER NOT NULL
                                  REFERENCES institutes(id)
                                  ON DELETE CASCADE,
            system            TEXT NOT NULL,
            year              INTEGER NOT NULL,
            category          TEXT NOT NULL,

        );
CREATE INDEX idx_institute_rankings_order
            ON institute_rankings(year, category, rank, rank_band);
CREATE INDEX idx_institutes_type
            ON institutes(institution_type);

From The Principal Desk
Mr. Jitendra Kumar Dawande
“Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.”
-Nelson Mandela
At Government College Bhainsdehi, we realize the significance of higher education in a person’s life. We believe it is our responsibility to provide an atmosphere of educational excellence along with other extra-curricular activities including community service programs for the all-round development of our students. As envisioned by Swami Vivekananda, we intend to provide our students with education which forms their character, increases the strength of their mind, expands their intellect and by which they can stand on their feet. The location of our college in rural area is a challenge for realization of our objectives and providing up to date facilities to the students. However, we take pride in the fact that our institute has steadily grown in various aspects since its establishment in 1982. Beginning with a Bachelor of Arts program with 42 students, the college now has Bachelors Programs in Arts, Science and commerce along with Masters Programs in four subjects – Economics, Political Science, Hindi Literature and Sociology. Our institute is constantly striving to provide quality education to students of rural areas. The selection of our college under the Madhya Pradesh Higher Education Quality Improvement Project has boosted the prospects of campus infrastructure. It is a matter of pride for us that our college has been selected for the establishment of Quality Learning Center under the ‘Aatmanirbhar Madhya Pradesh’ initiative of the Government of Madhya Pradesh. We aspire to make the most of this opportunity and continue our mission of providing quality education to our students.

Profile
The government college bhainsdehi was started by the state government in september 1982, at village navapur, tehsil bhainsdehi district betul, madhya pradesh.  the main aim for the establishment of college is providing education for social cultural, spiritual and intellectual development of rural and urban students. the total area of college is about 16 acres. the college started its journey in three rooms provided by govt. higher secondary school bhainsdehi with degree of bachelor in arts course with 42 students. bachelor of commerce was started in the year 1987. in the year 2010-11 college was shifted in its own building. bachelor of science  and pg (art subjects) in four subjects started in the year 2012-13.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "sqlite3 -header -csv 'file:assets/data/career_path.db?mode=ro' \"WITH RECURSIVE tree(id,slug,name,stream_id,parent_id,breadcrumb) AS (SELECT id,slug,name,stream_id,parent_id,name FROM career_nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.id,c.slug,c.name,c.stream_id,c.parent_id,tree.breadcrumb || ' > ' || c.name FROM career_nodes c JOIN tree ON c.parent_id=tree.id) SELECT tree.id,tree.slug,tree.breadcrumb,s.name AS stream FROM tree JOIN streams s ON s.id=tree.stream_id WHERE lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%science%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%math%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%chem%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%physics%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%biology%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%botany%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%zoology%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%commerce%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%econom%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%political%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%sociolog%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%history%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%english%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%hindi%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%literature%' OR lower(tree.breadcrumb) LIKE '%home science%' LIMIT 1000;\""
